# Know Your Meme & Scientific American

> > A mixed collection documenting viral internet culture through Know Your Meme's meme encyclopedia and Scientific American's science journalism.

This site appears to aggregate content from Know Your Meme, which tracks viral memes, trends, and internet phenomena primarily from TikTok, Twitter, and other social platforms, alongside Scientific American's subscription and policy pages. The content focuses heavily on explaining contemporary internet culture and viral trends.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Exploitable memes and image macros
- Viral catchphrases and dance trends
- Internet culture documentation
- Social media platforms (Twitter/X, Facebook, DeviantArt)
- Contemporary meme formats
- Hood movie nostalgia trends
- Cat memes and animal content
- Music-based viral trends
- Cultural commentary and explainers

## Meme Reference Database

- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme entry: girl lying over cat/kitten viral image trend
- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok catchphrase trend from BunnaB & YKNiece's 'Innit' song
